_doc: Maps world metres (x east, z south; north = -z) to map-image pixels. px = origin_px[0] + x_m*px_per_m ; py = origin_px[1] + z_m*px_per_m. If case/case.json has a 'map' object {image, px_per_m, origin_px:[x,y]} (origin_px = pixel of world (0,0)) it overrides these defaults. If origin_px is omitted the image centre is used as world origin.
